column1: # Pharo icon key -> Material Symbols Rounded, for MaterialSymbolsThemeIcons (scripts/generate.py reads it).
# Tab-separated. Lines that begin with # are comments; the first other line is the header. Columns (by name, in any order):
#   pharoKey    a key of svgPack (scripts/pharo-icon-keys.tsv), mapped at most once
#   symbolName  a Material Symbols Rounded icon of the pin (scripts/manifest-symbols.json)
#   grade       0, or 200: heavier strokes, the same size (closer to the weight of svgPack)
#   colour      RRGGBB for a fixed colour (the status keys), or - for the text colour of the UI theme
#   trim        optional: - (or empty) to keep Material's padding, or a margin M of 0 to 480 units of the 960 grid of
#               the symbol: its viewBox becomes the bounds of its ink (alpha above 8 at 960 px) plus M on each side,
#               widened or heightened about the centre to the aspect of the key, so the glyph fills the key
#   size        optional: WIDTHxHEIGHT at scale 1, or -; when given it must be that of scripts/pharo-icon-keys.tsv
#   note        optional, free text; any other column is ignored too (here: confidence, high/medium/low)
# Each key is drawn from the optical size 24 at the sizes svgPack draws it at (scales 1, 1.5 and 2), the symbol
# centred at the side of the shorter edge when the key is not square (a trimmed key fills all of it). Keys left out
# keep the icon of the previous pack.
# The generator stops on any unknown key or name, or wrong value, and lists every wrong line.
# 375 of the 377 keys of svgPack are mapped. Chosen from the senders of each key in Pharo 12 and 15 and from
# svgPack's pictures, checked side by side with the symbols. The conventions:
#   - outlined symbols take grade 200 (closer to svgPack's weight); filled ones grade 0
#   - fixed colours only for status: tests, errors, warnings, information, questions and confirm, breakpoint and
#     halt, uncommentedClass (red), the coloured dots (red, green, grey) and the buttons of inactive windows
#     (*Inactive*, grey 9E9E9E, the passive look of svgPack), the tab close crosses (close, glamorousClose: a small
#     grey 808080 X, as svgPack's) and flag (orange, as svgPack's); everything else follows the UI theme
#   - trimmed (trim): the keys of 10 px or less whose symbol would be a speck in Material's padding (the small
#     triangles, arrowUpAndDown, expandBox, removeCross, haloCollapse, tinyMenu), go/glamorousGo/smallDoIt (13 px),
#     greenArrowUpAndDown, every 12x12 check box (a crisp box of the full 12 px), the rules separator and
#     protocolNone, solidMenu (bars on whole pixels), the four windowMenu triangles (as large as svgPack's) and the
#     coloured dots and rings (as small as svgPack's)
#   - keys that Pharo 15 renamed (glamorousX -> x) and keys whose only difference is the state or the theme
#     (Inactive, Inverted, Dark, Pressed...) map to the same symbol
#   - brand logos (Pharo, git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) have no Material counterpart: the nearest symbol, low
# Left out on purpose (they keep svgPack's transparent Form):
#   blank   transparent 16x1 spacer, the default icon of commands without one (CmUICommandGroup, IceTipCommand):
#           any glyph would be drawn on all of them
#   empty   transparent 12x12 spacer (Epicea, FastTable), for the same reason
